caption: The drawing depicts a decorative alcove or niche with an arched top, outlined in earthy brown and gold tones. The interior of the alcove features a domed, striped backdrop composed of subtle pastel hues including light pink, blue, and cream that create a soft, swirling pattern. The vertical sides of the structure are flanked by rounded columns in brownish-red with blue accents at the top and bottom. On both upper corners of the columns, there are small decorative finials in a combination of blue and reddish-pink colors. The sides of the alcove have stylized green leaf-like motifs that curve outward. The entire composition sits against a plain, off-white background without any additional objects or details.
title: Sanctum, Carved from Wood
